title: Distributed sync, jobs, and recovery
subtitle: Reason about stale workers and partial writes using explicit state.
goal: Recover background work after crashes and takeovers
intro: Workers need durable ownership and safe repeated effects, not just a queue of IDs.
terms: Durable downstream work recorded with a business change
An ownership revision checked during writes
case: A worker sends a notification and crashes before marking completion.
A retry must recover without assuming the previous attempt did nothing.
Exactly-once effects do not follow from row selection alone.
